reviews.body: Found one P2 test-coverage gap in the new invoice search endpoint. All 9 existing tests and the TypeScript check pass; no concrete functional or security defects were identified.

comments.body:
🟡 **P2** · 🐛 **Bug**

The added tests only exercise `containsPattern`; none calls `GET /invoices`. Removing customer-name matching or omitting the search filter from the count query would still leave every test passing. Add route/database tests for case-insensitive partial matches on both fields, literal wildcard searches, combined `status`/`customer_id` filters, and a paginated result whose `total` reflects all matching rows.
